reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years because storing confidential ITR and PAN documents in external databases is an unacceptable liability. Even though Docketra keeps files in Google Drive, I will not pay a single rupee until I personally verify that connecting Drive will not grant Docketra access to read the rest of my firm's private files.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: Independent technical verification during the free pilot proving that OAuth permissions strictly restrict Docketra to the /Docketra/ folder with zero read access to any existing client files.
